about: EmberEngine's own character progression (the user, 2026-10-17). gain = what each level adds: hp atk mag def dex. Level 1 = the first class's row in content/engine2/class-stats.json (its MAG column is ours: Kael 5, Aldric 5, Neera 6, Salazar 8, Voss 10, Malrec 10). classes = the Engine2 classes the hero plays as (the first one's gains are the old ones; promotions keep the hero's gains). Enemies keep their class's own fixed start and gain per level, no multiplier, plus 3 attribute points per level after the first, rolled per unit as the battle loads by what it uses (the user, 2026-10-19; engine/world/Progression.cpp enemyPoints).

Selene.note: the user, 2026-10-26: a Conjuradora's gains + 1 ATK every level, and already +3 ATK at level 1; sharesClass: Malrec stays the conjurer class's hero
